title: Chapter 91 Who Are You?
content:
Chapter 91 Who Are You?

On the day Luo Li died, it was not only Yu Qingfeng who was heartbroken, but also this old man who was in his twilight years.

The fact that he could hold on until today was probably the last bit of obsession in his heart.

Until today, Luo Li was resurrected.

Yu Qingfeng broke through the Divine Emperor Realm and found his belonging. He was finally able to leave with peace of mind.

Somewhere in the starry sky.

Yu Qingfeng suddenly trembled all over, and then a line of hot tears slid down from the corners of his eyes.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng shook his head.

For a person who wanted to die, he couldn't do anything.

"Qingfeng, what's wrong with you?"

Luo Li looked at Yu Qingfeng who was crying silently with concern, and quickly took out a handkerchief to wipe Yu Qingfeng's tears.

Looking at Luo Li, Yu Qingfeng suppressed the sadness in his heart.

"Luo Li, I'm fine, let's go."

Hearing this answer, Luo Li knew that Yu Qingfeng was hiding something from her.

But she didn't ask, just nodded obediently.

Looking at Luo Li, Lu Daosheng on the side was silent.

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly said: "When you arrive in the deserted city, Luo Li, you should also start practicing."

Although Luo Li did not have any talent for practice, with his resources, it was not difficult to improve Luo Li's qualifications and let Luo Li step into the path of practice.

Hearing Luo Li's words, Yu Qingfeng hesitated and said: "Senior, this..."

Lu Daosheng said: "You can't protect her for a lifetime."

Then Lu Daosheng looked at Luo Li, "What do you think."

Hearing this, Luo Li looked at Yu Qingfeng, recalled the past, and her expression gradually became firm.

"Okay, senior, I want to practice too."

She didn't want to face the past again, the feeling of despair when Yu Qingfeng was not around.

Lu Daosheng was right, Yu Qingfeng could not always protect her, and she would not let others protect her for a lifetime.

Being strong by yourself is the truth.

Seeing this, Yu Qingfeng said nothing more.

He was also happy that Luo Li could practice, but he didn't want to trouble Lu Daosheng.

Because of Luo Li's aptitude, the resources consumed must be considerable.

However, what he didn't know was that those resources were not even a drop in the bucket in Lu Daosheng's eyes.

I don't know how long it took.

A huge city glowing with divine light appeared in everyone's sight.

It stood quietly in the starry sky, shocking the heavens and the earth, and awe-inspiring.

Yu Qingfeng and Jiang Bei were shocked when they saw this huge city.

Is this the deserted city?

It's even more awesome than imagined.

At this time, many practitioners had gathered outside the city.

"Senior, is this the deserted city?"

At this time, Yu Qingfeng asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng showed a slightly proud smile.

"How is it, not bad?"

This was made by him.

Yu Qingfeng and Jiang Bei nodded repeatedly.

After living for so many years, this is the first time they have seen such a huge city.

At this time, someone outside the city noticed Lu Daosheng and his group.

Seeing this, everyone frowned slightly.

Obviously, no one recognized Lu Daosheng and his group.

They must be from a small place and happened to pass by here.

Thinking of this, everyone turned their heads and stopped looking at Lu Daosheng and his group.

However, the next moment, they looked sideways again.

They saw that Lu Daosheng and his group actually began to walk towards the gate of the huge city.

They knew that they could not enter the city now.

However, they did not remind Lu Daosheng and his group.

After all, what does it have to do with them?

Just as Lu Daosheng was about to take Yu Qingfeng and his group into the deserted city, Lu Daosheng suddenly stopped and turned his head to look into the void behind him.

There, a figure was standing.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng's figure trembled and suddenly appeared in front of that person.

Seeing Lu Daosheng suddenly appearing in front of him, Wen Hong was frightened and stepped back.

"You, what do you want to do?"

Lu Daosheng gave him a terrifying feeling at this moment, which made Wen Hong very frightened.

What kind of terrifying strong man is this.

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly said: "Are you willing to follow me into the city?"

Hearing this, Wen Hong was stunned and said in shock: "Can you go in?"

Lu Daosheng nodded.

After a moment of silence, Wen Hong said: "If I go in with you, what do I have to pay?"

He knew that there is no free lunch in the world.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's mouth corners slightly raised, he is indeed a smart man.

Then Lu Daosheng smiled and said: "It's very simple, just join my deserted city."

Deserted city?

Wen Hong was stunned for a moment, and then he reacted immediately.

His face changed for a few moments, Wen Hong took a deep breath, and then nodded: "Okay, I'll join."

He believed that his inference would not be wrong.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled with satisfaction, grabbed Wen Hong, and then reappeared in front of the city gate.

Seeing Wen Hong in Lu Daosheng's hand, Jiang Bei and the others asked in confusion: "Senior, who is this?"

Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Let's go in first."

Then, Lu Daosheng reached forward and touched, and a gap suddenly appeared in the light curtain guarding the giant city.

"Go in."

Lu Daosheng took Wen Hong and stepped in first.

Seeing this, Jiang Bei and the others did not hesitate, and followed closely with Luo Li.

Outside the city, seeing this scene, the people around exploded directly.

"They, they went in?!"

"How is this possible?!"

In these days, except for a little girl who went in, no one else could go in.

Unexpectedly, this time, five people went in.

It seems that there is another person who is waiting for an opportunity outside the city like them.

For a moment, everyone outside was thinking a lot.

And inside the city.

As soon as they entered the city and saw the appearance of the city, except Lu Daosheng, everyone was stunned.

Deserted city.

It has nothing to do with desert.

Except that there are not many people in the city, everything else is impeccable.

And the few people are because of the light curtain that prohibits anyone from entering.

Yu Qingfeng and Jiang Bei's faces are gradually delighted. If they knew that this deserted city was like this, Jiang Bei might not even need to compete.

Luo Li didn't understand anything, but she could see that this city was extremely extraordinary.

As for Wen Hong, he had already laughed excitedly at this moment.

He made the right bet.

At this moment, several auras suddenly surged here.

Feeling the aura, Yu Qingfeng quickly protected Luo Li and looked at the distance vigilantly.

Jiang Bei also raised his eyebrows slightly.

Wen Hong had already guessed something and just stood there.

The next moment, more than 20 figures appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

It was Qin Yi and others.

"We, meet the Lord City Lord."

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Qin Yi and others were delighted and hurriedly said respectfully.

They didn't expect that Lu Daosheng would come back so soon.

Lu Daosheng nodded and was about to speak.

The next moment, a voice sounded from a distance.

"Dad, you're back!"

Lu Daosheng looked in the direction of the voice and saw Lu Xue running towards here with a woman.

Seeing the woman, Lu Daosheng's smile suddenly froze.

Buzz——

Lu Daosheng waved his hand directly, and a force instantly enveloped Lu Xue and brought Lu Xue to his side.

"Dad, you?"

Lu Xue looked at her father in confusion, a little confused.

But Lu Daosheng stared at Gongsun Yao not far away with a godly gaze.

"Who are you?"
